revisionTitle: F2 · RSS · Edge Radius Constraint Correction
authorityDecision: For the eight routes lacking exact legacy Figma surfaces, the user explicitly authorized the local canonical renderer as the visual, structural and interaction-intent source.

deltas.oldValue: Phone and Tablet RSS content existed only as raw Page 24 master children.
deltas.newValue: Exact clones became Page/RSS/CanonicalContent variants; no pixels, text, icons, alignment, density or effects changed.

deltas.oldValue: Refreshing, Empty, Error and Detail existed only as preserved Live Reference frames.
deltas.newValue: Exact clones became a four-variant Page/RSS/CanonicalState set; original Live Reference frames remain unchanged.
Each master contains one attached canonical content instance; original raw nodes remain preserved and hidden. Four Page 23 downstream instances remain attached.

deltas.oldValue: Eight local RSS list/category routes had no exact Figma surface and were blocked.
deltas.newValue: Added Page/RSS/CanonicalListRoute with Route=All/SourceFeed/Novel/Tech/Booklist/Releases/Issues/Discussions and Viewport=Phone/Tablet, using editable local-renderer captures as the source of truth.

deltas.oldValue: The 16 wrapper components used 0px corners; device children retained capture-dependent heights and Vertical=MIN. rss-all Tablet also contained an extra zero-radius wrapper.
deltas.newValue: All 16 wrappers and device children use the local 34px device radius on all four corners, exact 390x844 or 760x960 dimensions, clipsContent=true and horizontal/vertical STRETCH. rss-all Tablet now uses the exact editable device frame.

deltas.oldValue: No downstream Figma instances existed for the eight local-authorized routes.
deltas.newValue: Added 16 attached instances, one Phone and one Tablet instance per route; no detached frame is used as a deliverable.

deltas.oldValue: No editable provenance existed for the local-authorized routes.
deltas.newValue: All 16 editable capture roots are preserved hidden as __LOCAL_CAPTURE_SOURCE__; they are provenance only, never canonical masters or screenshots.

boundary: No UiEvent, reducer owner, async guard, route flow, motion contract or non-RSS canonical page family was changed. Existing RSS masters, Page 23 downstream instances and reactions were preserved.
